_comment: Copy to embedd.json (or point CANVAS_EMBEDD_CONFIG at it) to override the embedding providers and routing table. Absent = CPU-local ONNX text + CLIP images, i.e. the built-in defaults. Providers onnx/ollama/clip always exist; declaring one by the same id overrides its options. Rules match top-down, first match wins. `match.contentType` accepts an exact string, a `type/*` prefix, or an explicit `/regex/flags`. Changing a space's model or dim moves its vectors into their own Lance table with their own ledger, so the previous model stays intact and switching back costs a restart, not a re-embed. Reclaim a superseded model with DELETE /rest/v2/admin/workspaces/:id/vector-tables/:table.
